description: This file defines the MethodCallExpression class used in Twig's internal expression parsing to represent method call expressions within the template engine's abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: MethodCallExpression
classes.description: Represents a method call expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, handling compilation of method call expressions within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a MethodCallExpression, issuing deprecation warning and setting attributes based on the node type.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the method call expression into PHP code, either checking for method existence or performing the macro call.

calls: trigger_deprecation('twig/twig', '3.15', 'The "%s" class is deprecated, use "%s" instead.', __CLASS__, MacroReferenceExpression::class)
